description: React component for a user group header submenu with actions like edit, join, leave, and archive group.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: TypeScript type defining properties for the ViewUserGroupHeaderSubMenu component.

methods.name: goToEditGroupModal
methods.description: Opens the modal to edit user group details.

methods.name: leaveGroup
methods.description: Removes the current user from the group and decrements member count.

methods.name: joinGroup
methods.description: Adds the current user to the group and increments member count.

methods.name: archiveGroup
methods.description: Archives the group and triggers back button and exit actions.
